faq.question: What does Djibril mean?

faq.answer: Djibril is associated with Arabic. Djibril is the West African form of Arabic جِبْرِيل (Jibrīl), the Quranic name of the angel Gabriel.

faq.question: Is Djibril an Arabic name?
faq.answer: Yes — the underlying form جِبْرِيل is Arabic.

faq.question: Is Djibril an Islamic name?
faq.answer: Djibril can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.

faq.answer: Djibril should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Jibrīl is the Quranic Arabic name of the angel Gabriel and occurs in the Quran.
